meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把技术性内容用大白话拆开讲,覆盖 who、what、where、why、when 五个方面,产出通俗解释。
howto.when: 当你想要某段技术内容的通俗拆解,尤其是想弄清它涉及谁、是什么、在哪、为什么、什么时候时触发。

say.text: 把这个技术概念按谁、什么、在哪、为什么、何时拆开讲给我听
say.note: 得到五要素的大白话解释

say.text: 用大白话讲讲这个报错的 who、what、where、why、when
say.note: 针对报错做五要素拆解

say.text: 这段文档太技术了,拆成人话:谁、什么、哪、为什么、何时
say.note: 把技术文档转成通俗拆解

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude breaks technical material into plain English, covering the who, what, where, why, and when, and gives you a jargon-free explanation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a plain-English breakdown of something technical, especially the who, what, where, why, and when behind it.

say_en.text: Break this technical concept into who, what, where, why, and when for me
say_en.note: You get a plain-English five-part breakdown

say_en.text: Explain this error in plain English: who, what, where, why, when
say_en.note: A five-part breakdown of the error

say_en.text: This doc is too technical; explain the who, what, where, why, and when
say_en.note: Turns technical docs into a plain breakdown
